readings.meaning: do not disturb or quiet hours

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the Z inside the bell might look like a lightning bolt or a generic squiggle, making it look like an active ringing bell or power alert.

example_tasks.task: Schedule automatic quiet hours on my phone after 10pm
Snooze all non-urgent GitHub repository emails until next Monday
Set up a wind-down notification thirty minutes before bedtime
Silence noisy family group chats during deep work blocks
Allow calls from Mom and Dad to bypass focus mode
Check why calendar alerts keep firing overnight
Update the weekend schedule for the whole team
Review which apps are allowed to break through
Configure iOS Focus modes so work emails stop buzzing my watch every evening after seven
Pause all promotional push notifications from shopping and food delivery apps on my phone
Set a recurring 10:30pm sleep reminder on my watch so I stop staying up late

example_tasks_es: Programar el modo No molestar a partir de las diez de la noche
Silenciar las notificaciones del grupo del trabajo durante las vacaciones
Poner un recordatorio en el móvil para ir a dormir temprano
example_tasks_ru: Настроить режим «Не беспокоить» на телефоне после 22:00

context_tasks.task: Stop checking work email in bed
Hand over on-call pager duty to Alex for the long weekend
Clean up phone home screen to reduce distractions
Go to bed before midnight every weeknight this month

near_misses.task: Buy a new alarm clock for the bedroom
Order a quiet mechanical keyboard for the office
Book a sleep study appointment at the clinic
Buy melatonin gummies at the pharmacy
Check notifications from the bank about the wire transfer

reasoning: The bell with a 'Z' inside universally represents snoozing notifications, quiet hours, or Do Not Disturb mode. While it belongs to a relatively specific niche of tasks (configuring phone/app alerts, muting work notifications, or setting bedtime reminders), it is highly recognizable and distinct from a standard notification bell or muted bell.
